_doc: Seed allowlist for endpoints that pre-date the tier-gating lint. New endpoints should declare via inline `// tier: free|pro` marker; this file is for retrofit only. 2026-06-21 re-gating: the programmatic API is FREE; the only Pro gates are node count (servers POST quota), data retention (incl. the audit window), and AI analysis. See ~/Documents/Glassmkr/Reference/POLICY_TIER_GATING.md. Each entry: {path, method, tier} where tier in {free,pro}.
